'''Ran Dan's Folly''' was a mining colony at the South Pole on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sunspot (Tython system)|Sunspot]] in the [[Tython system/Legends|Tython system]]. The outpost mined [[petonium]] and [[marionium]], two elements used for energy. An accident that resulted in the [[Death/Legends|death]] of a hundred miners occurred in [[25,823 BBY]], and a strike occurred at the colony in [[25,811 BBY]], after which the mine was bought out by the miners and their families, who began trading with clients on three planets. It was abandoned by [[25,793 BBY]].<ref name="Into the Void" />
